verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's official CLI, SDK and REST API document programmatic instance lifecycle control. Specifically, the SDK shows `start_instance`, a runtime probe confirmed `create instance` and `destroy instance` in the CLI, and docs state instances bill by the second for actual usage. Stop and restart are not explicitly shown, and billing for stopped instances is not documented. missing for 10: explicit stop/restart commands or endpoints, documentation of what (if anything) is charged while an instance is stopped (e.g., storage), hands-on corroboration of the full start/stop/destroy cycle.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start, stop, restart, and terminate instances programmatically and keep paying only for what is running

citations.quote: `vastai --help` prints the full command surface including search offers, create instance, and destroy instance.
The Vast.ai CLI gives you command-line access to the entire platform, authentication, GPU search, instance lifecycle, templates, volumes, serverless endpoints, and more.
